title: Sharing Opinions
objective: State a clear opinion, give a reason for it, and soften disagreement politely.
aiRole: a friendly discussion partner who keeps asking why you think so
learnerRole: someone sharing and defending your own views
opening: Let's talk about work and study habits. What's your opinion on working from home?
targetSentences: In my opinion, working from home is better.
I prefer to study in the morning.
The main reason is that it saves time.
However, I agree there are some problems.
